s1n_fatih.wealth: 西营焦门氏（传奇往上不看家境）
s1n_fatih.why: 原页定为传奇，按规矩取这一纪顶上那一身，家境不再计较；他是破过九十九座城门的叩城者，资料里没有偏朴素或不穿甲的来由，所以照常。犁的年月西边还没有火药，就用焦门的黑皮、铁环袖口和门钉铁打成整套的附魔重甲，配色仍是黑、铁色和余烬红。
s1n_fatih.battle: The door-ram at a crossing, in the finest war harness of the western camps: a heavy black leather long coat with iron-ringed cuffs over a full fitted cuirass of blackened enchanted iron scales, each scale edged with a thin ember-red rune line; massive pauldrons of dark forged gate-iron studded with rows of old nail heads, their seams glowing like cooling embers; black iron vambraces banded with obsidian rings; heavy iron-shod hide boots; a sheepskin mantle thrown over the right shoulder. He holds the sword Embergate in both hands: a long straight single-edged blade, NOT a curved sword, forged from old gate nails, the round nail heads still showing in rows along its dark iron flat with embers glowing between them. A calm, courteous stare.

s3n_iskan.rank: 英雄（原页★：649年以前是英雄里最高的一截）
s3n_iskan.wealth: 中（南沼灰旗后人，走唱的班子）
s3n_iskan.pref: 不靠装备（歌者，靠自己的火）
s3n_iskan.why: 位阶是英雄，到这一档已经不看家境，本该是第4档的好东西。可他不拿兵器，苏伦讲过残炭焐亮角的事，他知道这把火不用谁给，所以不穿甲，只把走唱的行头换成量身做的上等一身，再加一件会亮的披风。
s3n_iskan.battle: Singing on the march, in no armour by his own choice, only a player's road clothes of the finest make: the canvas coat tailored close and belted over a fitted dark leather vest, the long multicoloured scarf knotted at the throat, the small brass bell at his belt humming faintly with each note; a dark short cloak thrown back, its lining stitched with fine warm-gold song-thread that glows as he sings; good scuffed boots. He carries no weapon. One hand is raised high and open, a warm flame-coloured light gathering in the palm, and the other rests on his chest. His mouth is open in song and his braid swings.

s3n_brodja.rank: 英雄（原页★：649年以前是英雄里最高的一截）
s3n_brodja.wealth: 中上（炉城深井一支，托娃錾令的后人，匠人世家）
s3n_brodja.pref: 照常（匠人的路子，战装是炉工的式样）
s3n_brodja.why: 位阶是英雄，又出身炉城的錾令匠人世家，所以是第4档自家打的、设计过的一身。她的本事在錾和炉灯上，所以战装照炉前干活的样子做，护的是身子和手，刻的是她自己的令字。
s3n_brodja.battle: Carving a forge into the walls, in the Deepwell carver's war kit forged to her own measure: a short jerkin of riveted dark-bronze plates over the canvas shirt, each plate engraved with command letters that hold a forge-orange glow; a heavy enchanted leather apron faced with small steel scales; heat-proof rune-etched gauntlets; plated greaves over steel-toed boots; a belt of chisels whose edges gleam with fire-light. She holds the forge-lamp up in her left hand and a long iron chisel raised in her right as if about to strike, with lines of lettering glowing with trapped fire around her hands. A still, intent face.

s4n_moga.why: 原页写明664年凝名时在极境，按位阶底子是3档。她是里德营的老兵，营已经覆没，人在水磨村靠别人家留床养伤，家境贫，极境可减一档，所以落在2档：一套改合身的旧营附魔甲，长斧算那一件像样的。她不戴首饰，日常穿补过的发放皮甲，这些照旧保留，但没有理由判成朴素或不靠装备。新朝的旧铜甲是668年以后才发的，她这一身仍是南线旧营的东西。
s4n_moga.battle: Holding the road before the shut gate, in her lost battalion's old war gear refitted to her frame: the patched issue leather jerkin worn over a grey wall-issue enchanted mail shirt whose rings glint with a faint blue-white rune line at the hem; a single heavy enchanted pauldron re-strapped on the left shoulder, the battalion's stitched mark scratched into it, one small magic crystal still lit in its socket; rune-etched steel vambraces with a scuffed glow; a grey-green scarf knotted at the throat; the nut pouch at the right hip. She grips the long-hafted battle axe in both hands and holds it across her body at chest height like a barrier, an old war crystal set at the head's collar glowing pale and a thin rune line running along the chipped edge. The feet are planted wide, the brows drawn down, the mouth set, the tusk tips showing.
